correctness.rationale: The difference coding lifts exactly: a finite difference block occurring in the Sturmian shift is realized at a regular rotation intercept, and an integer translate gives the required initial letter modulo m. On each unit cell the length-n floor vector is componentwise nondecreasing with each coordinate varying by at most one, so distinct intervals give distinct words even modulo m≥2; the first letter separates different cells. The endpoint limits add no words. Uniform irrational-rotation frequencies for these intervals give unique invariant cylinder frequencies. A singular orbit may meet several of the n-block cuts but at most once per cut; the endpoint convention therefore changes counts by a bounded amount. The normalized Kesten condition is length in αZ+mZ; for sufficiency, the half-open indicator minus its mean is a difference of shifted fractional-part functions with shifts separated by an integer rotation iterate, hence its counts telescope uniformly. Reversing orientation and lifting a unit gap whose successor displacement is d gives length {dα}; irrationality makes its membership equivalent to m dividing floor(dα). The three successor candidates follow by comparing to the closest positive and negative returns: a+b≥n (otherwise the return at a+b improves one of the two extremes); in the middle strip n−a≤i<b a shorter positive displacement d<a would give a return at a−d closer on the negative side, and a shorter negative displacement −d with d<b would improve the positive return at b−d. The outer strips give the same exclusions using the respective one-sided minimum; their sizes and the middle size are n−a, n−b, a+b−n. At n=2 the middle is empty, while at n=1 length one cannot satisfy the criterion. For the Fibonacci step, the two pairs (F_{r-1},F_{r-2}) and (F_{r-2},F_{r-3}) form a unimodular basis of integer (index, numerator) pairs, with opposite signed errors by the Fibonacci identity. A closer return at 0<d<F_r cannot take two positive basis coefficients (index at least F_r), two nonpositive ones (nonpositive index), or one positive and one nonpositive (error at least the corresponding extremal error). The signed displacement (−1)^{j−1}F_j has floor (−1)^{j−1}F_{j−1}; Fibonacci parity then gives exactly the three phases and their density limits. I also independently sorted all m n actual lifted cuts using exact integer comparisons of quadratic irrationals, reproducing 3,072 direct counts and 15 Fibonacci cases; replay python3 /workspace/reproductions/sturmian1.py. The uploaded checker was inspected, not executed.
residual_risks: Recorded 640 successor-map tests includes four n=1 no-op calls in CHECK.py, i.e. 636 nontrivial tested maps. This does not affect the exact argument.

value.rationale: Bounded discrepancy is a stronger property than uniform word frequency. An explicit census for the natural finite cyclic extension reduces m n words to three modular tests with known multiplicities, and shows genuine oscillation of the fraction of bounded-remainder cylinders: in the simplest Fibonacci binary lift entire lengths have none while other phases have positive limiting fractions. This supplies quantitative symbolic information not provided by strict ergodicity or the mere existence of at most three gap sizes.
residual_risks: The phase law is specific to the golden slope at modulus two, and is a fraction of words, not the measure of their union.
